Import a standardized NIST MSP spectral library

Source: R/import_msp.R
import_msp.Rd

Full-featured importer for clean NIST-format .msp files. Supports filtering by spectrum type, ion polarity, ionization method, collision energy and instrument name. Applies smart deduplication — all implemented in C++ for performance.

Use this function for:

  • MoNA .msp downloads

  • Files previously converted with convert_to_nist_msp

  • Any NIST-standard .msp file

For raw non-standard files (Bruker .library, CSU-PMF .mspLib), use read_library → convert_to_nist_msp first.

Usage

import_msp(
  file_path,
  spectrum_type = NULL,
  ionPolarity = NULL,
  ioniMethod = NULL,
  colEnergy = NULL,
  instName = NULL,
  filter = NULL,
  dedup_by = c("name_adduct_mode_energy", "name_adduct_mode", "name_only", "none"),
  require_formula = FALSE,
  reserve_n = 60000L,
  max_records = -1L
)

Arguments

file_path

Path to the NIST .msp file.

spectrum_type

Optional filter: "MS1" or "MS2". MoNA entries labelled Spectrum_type: MS match "MS1".

ionPolarity

Optional filter: "POSITIVE" or "NEGATIVE" (also accepts "pos", "neg", "P", "N").

ioniMethod

Optional filter for ionization method (string match).

colEnergy

Optional filter for collision energy (string match).

instName

Optional filter for instrument name (string match).

filter

Optional filter for metadata fields. Accepts either:

  • A single named list with elements field and pattern — drops entries whose field does not contain the pattern:

    filter = list(field   = "Instrument_type",
                 pattern = "LC-ESI-QTOF")

  • A list of such named lists for multiple conditions (AND logic — all conditions must be satisfied):

    filter = list(
      list(field = "Instrument_type", pattern = "LC-ESI-QTOF"),
      list(field = "Instrument",      pattern = "Agilent 6520 QTOF")
    )

Match is case-sensitive and fixed.

dedup_by

Deduplication grouping key:

"name_adduct_mode_energy"

(default) One entry per Name + Adduct + IonMode + CollisionEnergy. Preserves fragmentation diversity across energies — recommended for MoNA MS2.

"name_adduct_mode"

One entry per Name + Adduct + IonMode.

"name_only"

One entry per compound name — recommended for CSU-PMF and other MS1 libraries where collision energy variants are not meaningful. Keeps the entry with the most peaks.

"none"

No deduplication — keep all entries. Recommended for small in-house libraries.

require_formula

Logical. If TRUE, entries with a missing or invalid formula ("unk", empty) are discarded after parsing. Default FALSE. Set to TRUE when exact mass is required for downstream matching or annotation — for example, CSU-PMF MS1 libraries where entries without a formula cannot be used.

reserve_n

Memory hint: expected number of compounds (default 60000). Increase for very large files to reduce internal reallocations.

max_records

Integer. Stop after this many records (-1 = no limit).

Value

A named list of compounds. Each element contains standardized metadata fields and a Peaks data frame (mz, rel_intensity).

See also

read_library, convert_to_nist_msp, calculate_exact_mass

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# MoNA MS1 QTOF library — single instrument type filter
mona_lib <- import_msp(
  system.file("extdata", "Massbank_MS1",
              "massbank_result.nist_msp_MS1_TOF.msp", package = "MS1Match"),
  spectrum_type = "MS1",
  ionPolarity   = "POSITIVE",
  dedup_by      = "name_only",
  filter        = list(field = "Instrument_type", pattern = "LC-ESI-QTOF")
)

# Filter by both instrument type AND specific instrument model
# Keeps only Agilent 6520 QTOF entries
mona_agilent <- import_msp(
  "ms1_tof_positive_filtered.msp",
  spectrum_type = "MS1",
  ionPolarity   = "pos",
  filter = list(
    list(field = "Instrument_type", pattern = "LC-ESI-QTOF"),
    list(field = "Instrument",      pattern = "Agilent 6520 QTOF")
  )
)

# Filter by instrument type only (keeps all LC-ESI-QTOF regardless of model)
mona_qtof <- import_msp(
  "ms1_tof_positive_filtered.msp",
  spectrum_type = "MS1",
  ionPolarity   = "pos",
  filter        = list(field = "Instrument_type", pattern = "LC-ESI-QTOF")
)

# No filter — import everything in the pre-filtered MSP
mona_all <- import_msp(
  "ms1_tof_positive_filtered.msp",
  spectrum_type = "MS1",
  ionPolarity   = "pos"
)

# In-house MS1 library (after conversion from Bruker .library)
inhouse_lib <- import_msp(
  system.file("extdata", "CBIO", "CBIO_Standards.msp", package = "MS1Match"),
  spectrum_type = "MS1",
  dedup_by      = "name_only"
)

# CSU-PMF MS1 library — one entry per compound, formula required
csu_lib <- import_msp(
  system.file("extdata", "CSUPMF_C8_lib", "CSUPMF_library.msp",
              package = "MS1Match"),
  spectrum_type   = "MS1",
  dedup_by        = "name_only",
  require_formula = TRUE
)

# Access individual compounds
inhouse_lib[["Caffeine"]]$ExactMass
inhouse_lib[["Caffeine"]]$Peaks
} # }
